name: hike-up-maintenance
description: HIKE UP General Maintenance — website, customer portal and admin platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @hikeup/api" "npm run dev -w @hikeup/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @hikeup/api && npm run build -w @hikeup/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hikeup/ui && npm run test -w @hikeup/api && npm run test -w @hikeup/web
